definitions.short: fewness ; by implication, as superlative diminutiveness
definitions.full: H4213. mizar מִזְעָר noun [masculine] a little, a trifle, a few . 1 of time מִזְעָ֑ר מְעַט עוֺד Isa 10:25 ; 29:17 yet a trifle, a little = a very little while. 2 of number שְׁאָר מִזְעָר מְעַט Isa 16:14 a remnant, a very few (opposed to בִּיר כַּ לוֺא ). In Isa 3 without מעט : — אנושׁ ׃ונשׁאר מִזְעָֽר 24:6 .
